objective: Provide guaranteed monthly pension to all citizens, particularly unorganised sector workers.
description: Defined contributory pension scheme regulated by PFRDA. Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1000 to Rs 5000 at age 60 depending on contribution amount and entry age. On subscriber death, spouse receives the same pension; on spouse death, corpus returned to nominee. Existing Swavalamban subscribers migrated to APY. Charges levied for delayed/non-payment.
implementing_agency: PFRDA, Banks, Post Offices (DoP CBS Platform), Business Correspondents
regulatory_body: PFRDA (Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority)
